## Fitness Studio Business Management Software FAQs

We know you have questions about how our fitness studio management software can streamline your operations and help your business grow. If you don’t see your question here, schedule a demo and one of our specialists can help you.

### What is a fitness business management software system?

A fitness business management system helps studios manage bookings, memberships, payments, staff schedules, and client communication from one platform. Instead of relying on multiple disconnected tools, owners can streamline daily operations in a single system. WellnessLiving also includes built-in marketing, reporting, and client engagement features to help businesses operate more efficiently and grow with confidence.

### Can CRMs designed for fitness clubs improve efficiency?

Yes. A fitness CRM centralizes client information, automates follow-ups, and tracks every stage of the customer journey. WellnessLiving combines CRM functionality with scheduling, billing, marketing, and reporting, eliminating the need for separate software. This saves time, improves client relationships, and helps staff focus on delivering exceptional experiences.

### How much does an AI receptionist for a fitness center cost?

The cost depends on the provider and available features. Some AI receptionists charge monthly subscriptions, while others use usage-based pricing. WellnessLiving's AI receptionist, CAASI, is designed specifically for fitness businesses and helps answer client questions, recommend services, and encourage online bookings. Businesses should compare overall value, automation capabilities, and revenue impact instead of price alone.

### How does WellnessLiving compare to Mindbody for gyms and fitness studios?

WellnessLiving provides an all-in-one platform built to help fitness businesses attract, convert, and retain more clients. Unlike platforms that require additional paid add-ons, WellnessLiving includes powerful marketing automation, rewards programs, reporting, and client engagement tools in one connected system. Combined with responsive customer support and AI-powered features, it offers gyms and fitness studios a scalable solution for long-term growth.

### How much does fitness studio management software cost?

Pricing varies based on business size, features, and software provider. Some platforms charge additional fees for marketing, reporting, or mobile apps, increasing the total cost over time. WellnessLiving combines essential business management and growth tools into one platform, helping fitness studios maximize value while reducing the need for multiple software subscriptions.

### What features does WellnessLiving’s fitness studio software offer?

WellnessLiving’s fitness studio software provides essential tools for fitness studio owners, including class scheduling, client check-ins, automated reminders, and comprehensive client management. These features streamline operations by handling payments, tracking visits, and offering actionable insights––helping fitness studio owners grow and manage their fitness businesses more efficiently.

### How can WellnessLiving’s fitness studio management software help manage class schedules and bookings?

WellnessLiving’s fitness studio management software includes advanced scheduling features such as online booking, waitlists, and recurring class options. With the Achieve Client App, members can book classes, join waitlists, or cancel bookings on-the-go, while real-time updates keep your schedule accurate and accessible.

### Is WellnessLiving’s fitness studio software suitable for both small and large fitness studios?

Absolutely! WellnessLiving’s fitness studio management software is designed for fitness businesses of all sizes, from small operations to multi-location franchises. Our scalable platform offers robust solutions for class scheduling, client management, and reporting. Multi-location fitness studios benefit from the Enterprise Cloud, which consolidates data and simplifies management across all locations, ensuring smooth operations and growth at scale.

### What automated marketing tools are available in WellnessLiving’s fitness studio software?

Our fitness management software features powerful automated marketing tools, including email, SMS, and push notifications to help increase client engagement and retention.
